decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range is cheap to keep in the catalogue, and architectural hardware product lifecycles run many years.
A newly launched handle family with several models fits the firm's system breadth strategy and is unlikely to be withdrawn after one year.
A single handle design carries some risk of rationalisation but is too recent to drop given long specification cycles with architects.
A single new design close to the established offer is low-cost to maintain and needs time to gain traction in projects.
A handle family with several models supports design breadth across budget levels and is likely to stay.
This is the flagship electronic access system with unique light technology and is central to the firm's push into digital building organisation.
